topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic and sets expectations regarding the complexity and importance of the complement system.

topics.label: Overview and Core Mechanics of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the fundamental organization, terminology, and central role of C3 in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Complement Activation Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the recognition pathways that initiate complement activation and converge to form surface-bound C3 convertases.

topics.label: Effector Functions of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the downstream mechanisms through which activated complement carries out pathogen destruction and immune clearance.

topics.label: Host Regulation of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory proteins that control the complement cascade and prevent accidental destruction of host cells.

topics.label: Clinical Complement Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the distinct clinical presentations and disease risks associated with deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen Evasion of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the evolutionary mechanisms employed by pathogens to evade and inhibit complement-mediated immune destruction.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on the adaptive immune system.
